question: A girl goes to school at a speed of 45 km/h. She comes back with a speed of 36 km/h. Find her average speed for the whole journey.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal distances, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) / (S₁ + S₂)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 45 × 36) / (45 + 36)

⇒ Average Speed = 3240 / 81

⇒ Average Speed = 40 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 40 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed while going to school (S₁) = 45 km/h

Speed while returning home (S₂) = 36 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time
